common_conditions: 3GPP TS 23.280 V19.10.1, Release 19; other versions are not implied
Stage 2 information flows and procedures; not a wire-format implementation
condition_rule: Every claim inherits all common_conditions and adds its own conditions; do not extract a claim without both.

conditions: A subscribed MC service user cancels its subscription
claims.conclusion: Stop delivery to that subscriber; do not infer cancellation for all recipients.
Measurement time accompanies location information; accuracy is optional and at least one listed location element is supplied.

conditions: LMS has already subscribed to group dynamic data from the MC service server
The requesting LMC is subscribed and authorized for the target location information
Current affiliation is determined from the latest server notification
claims.conclusion: Track current affiliation and cancel the relevant group trigger when a user de-affiliates.

conditions: Recipient is subscribed and authorized to receive the target location information
claims.conclusion: Notification is not proof of a newly performed measurement.

conditions: For the notification procedure in 10.9.3.6.1, single MC system operation
claims.conclusion: Do not include the UE label in location notification to the MC service server.
